description.value:
Iaidō is more than a martial art. It demands razor-sharp concentration, an awareness of the here and now, conscious action that finds its expression in the lightning-quick technique of sword drawing. With this katana forged in the first half of the 20th century, no opponent will take you by surprise. And if they manage, they'll very quickly regret it.

Category: Super Luxury • Fabrication: You gotta get past Smasher first, choomba (Cannot be Fabricated, must be gifted or scavenged).

Class: Iconic EQ Heavy Melee • Skill: Melee Weapon • Range: 4m/yds

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: N/A • ROF: 2 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: None • Mods: Bladesmith (Sharpened)

Special Features: If this weapon’s target suffered a Critical Injury from this weapon or Nehan on the previous Round, then when this weapon now incurs a Critical Injury, it deals 10 additional Bonus Damage (15 Total) and restores 5 HP to its user.

Before this weapon has been drawn during Combat, the user can make a special ROF 1 Fluid Strike Attack where they attempt to draw and strike in one motion. If the Fluid Strike Attack succeeds, this weapon deals 2d6 additional damage (5d6) and when rolling for damage, 4s and 5s count as 6s for the purposes of incurring Critical Injuries. Fluid Strike cannot be used twice in a combat encounter.

Wielding or openly carrying this weapon adds a +2 bonus to Facedowns if the opponent is aware of who this sword normally belongs to, or a +4 bonus if they're also from Arasaka.

Fabrication: You gotta get past Smasher first, choomba (Cannot be Fabricated, must be gifted or scavenged).
Range: 4m/yds
Mods: Bladesmith (Sharpened)

Foundry notes:

  • Listed capacity is N/A; the sheet tracks 0.
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Super Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
